+// envVariableHookFunc replaces whole-string environment variable references
+// before the remaining decode hooks convert values to their target types.
+func envVariableHookFunc() mapstructure.DecodeHookFunc {
+	return func(from reflect.Kind, _ reflect.Kind, data interface{}) (interface{}, error) {
+		if from != reflect.String {
+			return data, nil
+		}
+
+		value := reflect.ValueOf(data).String()
+		if !envVariablePattern.MatchString(value) {
+			return data, nil
+		}
+
+		if env, ok := os.LookupEnv(value[2 : len(value)-1]); ok {
+			return env, nil
+		}
+
+		return data, nil
+	}
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,86 @@
+package config
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"os"
+	"reflect"
+	"testing"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/mitchellh/mapstructure"
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+)
+
+func TestEnvVariableHookFunc(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Setenv("FLIPT_TEST_SUBSTITUTION", "resolved")
+	t.Setenv("_FLIPT_TEST_SUBSTITUTION9", "underscored")
+	t.Setenv("FLIPT_TEST_SUBSTITUTION_EMPTY", "")
+	t.Setenv("FLIPT_TEST_SUBSTITUTION_UNSET", "temporary")
+	require.NoError(t, os.Unsetenv("FLIPT_TEST_SUBSTITUTION_UNSET"))
+
+	tests := []struct {
+		name  string
+		input any
+		want  any
+	}{
+		{"plain name", "${FLIPT_TEST_SUBSTITUTION}", "resolved"},
+		{"leading underscore and digit", "${_FLIPT_TEST_SUBSTITUTION9}", "underscored"},
+		{"empty variable value", "${FLIPT_TEST_SUBSTITUTION_EMPTY}", ""},
+		{"missing variable", "${FLIPT_TEST_SUBSTITUTION_UNSET}", "${FLIPT_TEST_SUBSTITUTION_UNSET}"},
+		{"leading whitespace", " ${FLIPT_TEST_SUBSTITUTION}", " ${FLIPT_TEST_SUBSTITUTION}"},
+		{"prefix", "prefix-${FLIPT_TEST_SUBSTITUTION}", "prefix-${FLIPT_TEST_SUBSTITUTION}"},
+		{"suffix", "${FLIPT_TEST_SUBSTITUTION}-suffix", "${FLIPT_TEST_SUBSTITUTION}-suffix"},
+		{"two references", "${FLIPT_TEST_SUBSTITUTION}${FLIPT_TEST_SUBSTITUTION}", "${FLIPT_TEST_SUBSTITUTION}${FLIPT_TEST_SUBSTITUTION}"},
+		{"leading digit", "${9FLIPT_TEST_SUBSTITUTION}", "${9FLIPT_TEST_SUBSTITUTION}"},
+		{"invalid punctuation", "${FLIPT-TEST}", "${FLIPT-TEST}"},
+		{"empty name", "${}", "${}"},
+		{"number", 42, 42},
+		{"boolean", true, true},
+	}
+
+	for _, tt := range tests {
+		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			got, err := mapstructure.DecodeHookExec(envVariableHookFunc(), reflect.ValueOf(tt.input), reflect.ValueOf(""))
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			require.Equal(t, tt.want, got)
+		})
+	}
+}
+
+func TestLoadEnvSubstitution(t *testing.T) {
+	for _, key := range []string{
+		"FLIPT_SERVER_HTTP_PORT",
+		"FLIPT_SERVER_HOST",
+		"FLIPT_LOG_ENCODING",
+		"FLIPT_LOG_LEVEL",
+		"FLIPT_CACHE_TTL",
+	} {
+		t.Setenv(key, "")
+		require.NoError(t, os.Unsetenv(key))
+	}
+
+	t.Setenv("FLIPT_TEST_LOG_ENCODING", "json")
+	t.Setenv("FLIPT_TEST_LOG_LEVEL", "DEBUG")
+	t.Setenv("FLIPT_TEST_HTTP_PORT", "8181")
+	t.Setenv("_FLIPT_TEST_HOST9", "127.0.0.1")
+	t.Setenv("FLIPT_TEST_CACHE_TTL", "2m")
+
+	path := "./testdata/env_substitution.yml"
+	result, err := Load(context.Background(), path)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.Equal(t, 8181, result.Config.Server.HTTPPort)
+	require.Equal(t, "127.0.0.1", result.Config.Server.Host)
+	require.Equal(t, LogEncodingJSON, result.Config.Log.Encoding)
+	require.Equal(t, "DEBUG", result.Config.Log.Level)
+	require.Equal(t, 2*time.Minute, result.Config.Cache.TTL)
+
+	t.Run("configuration environment overrides win", func(t *testing.T) {
+		t.Setenv("FLIPT_SERVER_HTTP_PORT", "8282")
+		t.Setenv("FLIPT_LOG_ENCODING", "console")
+
+		result, err := Load(context.Background(), path)
+		require.NoError(t, err)
+		require.Equal(t, 8282, result.Config.Server.HTTPPort)
+		require.Equal(t, LogEncodingConsole, result.Config.Log.Encoding)
+	})
+}
